# Baldevji Jitmal — Heritage Textiles Indore

> Baldevji Jitmal is a historic, family-run wholesale and retail traditional textile house located at 221, M.T. Cloth Market, Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. Specialising in authentic Indian weaves including dhotis, dupattas, ladies and gents shawls, pure cotton bedsheets, towels, Bhagalpuri silks, pooja aasans, and ceremonial fabrics.

Baldevji Jitmal has served wedding families, boutique retailers, and institutions for over eight decades from the heart of central India's historic fabric trading hub.

## Textile Collections & Categories

- [Traditional Dhotis & Sets](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Dhotis): Pure cotton dhotis, single dhotis, dupattas, and traditional ceremonial sets.
- [Artificial & Bhagalpuri Silk Sets](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Silk): Premium silk dhotis, dupattas, and heritage ceremonial attire.
- [Bhagalpuri Tussar & Chaddars](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Bhagalpuri): Authentic Bhagalpuri all-weather chaddars and dhoti-dupatta sets.
- [Kurta-Pajama Cloth](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Kurta%20Cloth): Unstitched linen, pure cotton, and blended fabric for traditional kurtas.
- [Ladies Shawls](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Ladies%20Shawl): Soft pashmina, cashmere-feel, and fine woollen shawls in classic paisley and floral jacquards.
- [Gents Shawls](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Gents%20Shawl): Understated masculine woollen shawls, lohis, and ceremonial wraps.
- [Pure Cotton Bedsheets](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Bedsheets): Single and double-bed pure cotton bedsheets for daily comfort and hospitality bulk orders.
- [Towels & Napkins](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Towels%2FNapkins): High-absorbency bath towels, hand towels, and cotton napkins for wholesale.
- [Readymade Free-Size Dhotis](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Readymade%20Dhoti): Pre-stitched, universal-fit dhotis tailored with full ceremonial fabric.
- [3-Piece Ceremonial Sets](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=3%20Piece%20Set): Complete coordinated set containing Dhoti, Dupatta, and Kurta fabric.
- [Pooja Aasan](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Aasan): Woollen, cotton, polyester, and velvet prayer mats in auspicious traditional prints.
- [Cotton & Silk Lungis](https://www.baldevjijitmal.in/gallery?category=Lungi): Authentic 2m, 2.25m, and 2.5m lungis in breathable weaves.
